observed_patterns_used: cards elevadas, testimonials y navegación sticky/fixed
variables CSS de color y tipografía similares al sistema Gravity
source_analysis.contrast_policy: AA/AAA-first: body text 7:1 target, CTA text >= 4.5:1

contrast_report.wcag_note: Valores >= 4.5 son AA para texto normal; bg_text apunta a >= 7 cuando el palette lo permite.

design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #FFF9EE; --surface: #FFFFFF; --surface-alt: #EFE4D0; --text: #17120A; --muted: #564936; --primary: #6D28D9; --accent: #A16207; --on-primary: #FFFFFF; --on-accent: #FFFFFF; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 18px; --gap: 32px; --blur: 14px; --nav-position: sticky; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Syncopate', sans-serif; } .hero--bento { min-height: 88vh; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr; grid-template-rows: 1fr auto; gap: var(--gap); } .hero-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, var(--primary))); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 64px); } .hero-card--main { grid-row: span 2; }  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
